description: ASK MARA ABOUT a fish she did not witness or get shown is ignorance, not a hint dump.

replacements.old:
(<EQUAL? .TOPIC ,DAM-SILVERFIN ,MUSEUM-AQUATIC-GALLERY-OBJECT>
           <COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-FISH-RELEASED>
                  <TELL "The silverfin record is stronger because the animal survived it, Mara says. A field note does not require a corpse to become official." CR>)
                 (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-FISH-WITNESSED>
                  <TELL "The silverfin's body matches the current it came from, Mara says. Observe the tail and flank before deciding whether a display case deserves the living evidence." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The River Frigid should be observed before it is harvested, Mara says. Water writes changes into living things more honestly than engineers write reports." CR>)>)
replacements.new:
(<EQUAL? .TOPIC ,DAM-SILVERFIN ,MUSEUM-AQUATIC-GALLERY-OBJECT>
           <COND (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-FISH-RELEASED>
                  <TELL "The silverfin record is stronger because the animal survived it, Mara says. A field note does not require a corpse to become official." CR>)
                 (<MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-FISH-WITNESSED>
                  <TELL "The silverfin's body matches the current it came from, Mara says. Observe the tail and flank before deciding whether a display case deserves the living evidence." CR>)
                 (<LC-GET ,LC-SLOT-TOLD-SILVER>
                  <TELL "You showed me that catch, Mara says. I can speak to what you placed in my hands, not to a fishing trip I did not walk." CR>)
                 (<LOC ,DAM-SILVERFIN>
                  <TELL "I have not seen that catch, Mara says. Do not ask me to curate a fish I never met." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The River Frigid should be observed before it is harvested, Mara says. Water writes changes into living things more honestly than engineers write reports." CR>)>)
          (<EQUAL? .TOPIC ,RESERVOIR-CHAR>
           <COND (<LC-GET ,LC-SLOT-CHAR-REL>
                  <COND (<MARA-HERE?>
                         <TELL "The char went back to still water, Mara says, if that is the release I watched." CR>)
                        (T
                         <TELL "I will not invent a reservoir ending I did not see." CR>)>)
                 (<EQUAL? <MARA-GET ,MARA-SLOT-LAST-EVIDENCE> ,RESERVOIR-CHAR>
                  <TELL "Still-water body, no gate scar, Mara says. That is a reservoir animal." CR>)
                 (<LC-GET ,LC-SLOT-TOLD-CHAR>
                  <TELL "You showed me the char, Mara says. That is all I honestly know of it." CR>)
                 (<LOC ,RESERVOIR-CHAR>
                  <TELL "I have not seen that catch, Mara says. The reservoir is not a rumor I will decorate." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "I have no reservoir specimen in evidence yet, Mara says." CR>)>)
